accepted_risks.risk: No human reviewer available (ASK/STOP points in the workflow).
accepted_risks.resolution: Chose the most defensible option from the evidence at each ASK/STOP point and proceeded, per run-specific override in TASK.md.

accepted_risks.risk: Original paper.txt is not available; only a pre-built evidence package (research_evidence.json, claim_candidates.json, missing_evidence.json) was provided.
accepted_risks.resolution: Treated the package as the output of workflow steps 1-2 and copied it into .rcs/evidence and .rcs/claims verbatim. Evidence locators refer to the original paper text (line numbers, table/figure numbers) which cannot be opened in this run; these are treated as provenance metadata, not verifiable in-session, and are not flagged as errors.

accepted_risks.risk: All claim_candidates.json entries have author_confirmation: pending, and no human is available to confirm them (Gate G1 normally requires user confirmation).
accepted_risks.resolution: Accepted all claims whose evidence IDs resolve to an E### item with strength='hard' or explicitly noted as author-stated quotes (i.e., the evidence package itself already represents authors' own paper text). Treated pending confirmations as accepted for the purpose of drafting, since the underlying evidence is drawn directly from the authors' own reported numbers/quotes, not from inference beyond that. This is recorded as an accepted risk rather than a resolved confirmation.

accepted_risks.risk: No web access; literature mode restricted to works mentioned inside the evidence package itself.
accepted_risks.resolution: Only two prior-work citations are mentioned by author-name in the evidence package: 'Narayanan et al.' and 'Likhomanenko et al.' (missing_evidence.json, SpeechStew comparison item), with no publication year given anywhere in the package. Registered these in corpus/source_registry.json with verification.method='user_supplied_file', read_depth='abstract', and year=null. In the manuscript they are cited as '(Narayanan et al.)' and '(Likhomanenko et al.)' without a fabricated year, since inventing a year would violate the never-invent rule. This is a deliberate, documented deviation from the strict '(FirstAuthor et al., Year)' format, chosen as more defensible than fabricating a year.

Used templates/venue_profile.generic.yaml with all rules marked assumed:true. Chose a standard ML-conference IMRaD-like structure suited to an adjacent-researcher audience, per TASK.md's explicit audience specification (mode B).

accepted_risks.risk: Evidence package gives point estimates only for most benchmark tables; missing_evidence.json flags absence of variance/CIs and significance testing (severity: moderate/high).
accepted_risks.resolution: Reported all numbers exactly as given, without implying statistical significance. Flagged the absence of variance data explicitly in Limitations, per missing_evidence.json items 1 and 10.

accepted_risks.risk: Per TASK.md run-specific constraints, step 18 (blind review) is performed externally, not by this agent.
accepted_risks.resolution: Stopped after step 17 (scientific overclaim audit). Did not fabricate a review. Wrote drafts/v001/paper.md and ./paper.md with claim tags kept, plus packets/audience.md and packets/objective.md, as instructed.
